subject: Q2 hiring matrix + exceptions request — Sales / CS / SE
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q2 hiring matrix + exceptions request — Sales / CS / SE

Team —

Attached is the updated Q2 hiring matrix (v3) and two offer exception requests where we need leadership sign-off before we extend. Quick summary:

- Roles requested: 2 Enterprise AEs (West), 1 Strategic CSM (healthcare vertical), 1 Solutions Engineer (pre-sales high-touch).
- Budget: hires fit within the Q2 hiring envelope, but two candidates require comp band exceptions: AE candidate #1 requests +12% above band (counteroffer situation), SE candidate is requesting a signing bonus outside the standard band.
- Rationale: both candidates have customer relationships and/or domain expertise that materially shorten ramp and reduce time-to-first-revenue for two open pilots.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you validate quota plan alignment for the AE exceptions (sheet, column H)?
- Karthik: please confirm whether we can authorize one-time signing bonus for the SE role and whether it needs VP approval beyond this thread.
- Monica: HR approval on comp paperwork and if the offer_exception_form_3.pdf is sufficient for records.

Timing: Recruiting has verbal acceptances on hold — would like to extend formal offers by Wednesday EOD PST.

Attachments: Q2_hiring_matrix_v3.xlsx (matrix with routing & cost), offer_exception_form_3.pdf (candidate justification + comparisons).

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q2 hiring matrix + exceptions request — Sales / CS / SE

Thanks Hannah — quick read and a couple of clarifying notes:

- On the AE +12% exception: the quota plan in the matrix (tab: quotas) shows adjusted OTE recovery in year 1 — that's fine from an ARR coverage standpoint if we treat this as a 12-month protected quota. I do want to confirm that the AE will be assigned to the East/West split as listed (sheet, column D) so we don't double-count coverage.
- For timing: Wednesday EOD is tight but doable if we get sign-off today/early tomorrow.
- Suggested change to offer text: include a 6-month performance milestone tied to accelerated on-target commission (to mitigate uplift risk). I'll draft language if approved.

Two small asks:
1) Hannah, can you add the candidate names (initials are fine) in the matrix to make the exceptions auditable?
2) Monica, HR needs confirmation that the signing bonus for the SE will be processed as a one-time payment (not folded into OTE).

Marissa
Sr. Dir, Go-to-Market Ops

Subject: Re: Q2 hiring matrix + exceptions request — Sales / CS / SE

Hannah / team —

I reviewed the matrix and exception form. High level: I support moving forward with both exceptions subject to documented mitigations. Please see my notes inline in the sheet (tab: exec_notes). Short summary:

- AE +12%: Approve at the hiring manager level if we add a 6-month acceleration milestone and cap on tenure-based uplifts. Must include a clawback provision if targets not met in months 6-12.
- SE signing bonus: Approve as a one-time payment. Requires VP approval for anything > $15k. The current request is $10k, so this is within my approval limit. HR (Monica) should confirm payroll treatment and cost-center coding.

Jordan: please make sure quota territory assignments are final before offer issuance. If there's any ambiguity, hold the offer until we reconcile territory.

I'll mark this as approved in the hiring matrix once Hannah confirms the milestone language.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Revenue Strategy

Hannah —

Confirmed from HR/payroll: the SE signing bonus will be processed as a one-time taxable payment on the candidate's first payroll run (code: 6SB-2027). We will not fold it into OTE. Please ensure offer letter language reflects the one-time nature and the clawback window (12 months).

Offer_exception_form_3.pdf looks complete; please add candidate initials and the manager justification on page 2 for auditability. Once the initials are added I will file in the compensation exceptions registry and mark as approved.
